messages:
Anya: Kicking off Novaflow POC perf/runbook thread. Sales ask: prove 3k qps sustained for their short-text endpoint (chat-like prompts), p99 < 200ms, analyze burst recovery and queueing. Window request: Thu 09:00 PT for 2h. They also want answers on KMS/HSM for keys and per-request encryption.

Tom: I can run load. Need payload mix and whether to test tokenized vs raw-text paths. Also confirm auth — API key for hosted, service account for dedicated.

Anya: Payload mix: 60% short (~32 toks), 35% medium (~128), 5% long (~400). Include a 1:4 ratio of streaming to non-streaming calls to exercise SSE paths. Test both hosted and a temp dedicated pool if capacity allows. Auth as you suggested.

Leo: Ops note: staging has 6x A10G available but not reserved. I can request a reservation for Thu 07:00-11:00 PT. If we need private (VPC) with customer HSM, that's ~72h for peering + certs. Hosted KMS envelope flows are good for most security asks.

Tom: Proposed runs:
- Ramp: 0 -> 3k qps over 12m, hold 45m (steady metrics)
- Burst test: repeating 30s spikes to 9k qps (3x) with 2m recovery in between, total 18m
- Cache-priming churn: 12k cold sessions over 12m to examine KV cache warm-up
I'll use vegeta for open-loop qps and a small Locust scenario for streaming concurrency.

Tom: Example vegeta snippet (will include full bodies in repo):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streamgen" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=3000 -duration=45m | vegeta report -type='HDR'
```
Instrument with X-Req-Id, X-Env and cost headers.

Anya: Acceptance criteria: p99(short+med) <= 200ms in steady-state, overall errors <0.3%, tail recovery within 90s after each burst, and sustained throughput within 5% of target for at least 80% of the steady window. Capture per-shard GPU utilization, queue backlog, and tokenized vs raw cost slides.

sec-team: Security Qs we expect: HSM proof (FIPS 140-2/3 levels), KMS envelope flow docs, network diagrams for Dedicated/Private, audit log retention, and pen test SOC2 timeline. If Novaflow requires BYOK with HSM import, ops lead time is ~72h.

Leo: Noted. I'll draft short bullet answers and attach a network diagram. Also requesting capacity approval now for Thu.

ops-bot: Reservation request submitted for 6x A10G on Thu 07:00-11:00 PT. Pending capacity approval.

Tom: I'll build the run repo under perf/novaflow with scripts and dashboards. Will post link once pushed. Also adding a small token-estimate calc for cost modeling. Rough calc: 3k qps * avg 60 tokens/request * 3600s = ~648M tokens/hour — will create a cleaner spreadsheet.

Anya: For pricing messaging: show hosted on-demand estimate and a Dedicated commit example that halves unit cost at high commit. Also call out burst overage billing.

Tom: Quick operational checks before run: ensure tracing headers map to dashboards, enable request sampling at 100% during the run, and turn on detailed GPU kernel logs for postmortem.

Leo: Capacity approved for 6x A10G. I've also attached a note: if we see degraded perf, we'll enable fallback to older model shim for graceful degradation.

Anya: Great. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your tasks are done. I'll collate everything and share the pre-run checklist 24h before.

Tom: :white_check_mark: targets and initial scripts drafted, validating payload distribution now.

Leo: :white_check_mark: capacity reserved and draft network diag uploaded.

sec-team: :white_check_mark: security bullet draft posted, added expected turnaround times for HSM/BYOK.

Anya: Thanks team. We'll use this thread for run artifacts and final results writeup.
